A FEW THINGS YOU MAY BE WONDERING

Good questions.
Clear answers.

A little clarity before you bring a new system into your center.

Is the software really free?

Yes. The core software is offered free for one diagnostic center with one active branch. Optional extensions are separate. Installation, hosting, training, and support arrangements should be discussed before setup.

Is this a full hospital management system?

HospitalSoftwere is focused on diagnostic centers: patient registration, test billing, samples, and reports. Pharmacy, appointments, inpatient care, and home collection are outside the v1 scope.

Can our team use it in Bangla?

The system is designed with Bangla and English interfaces, Unicode patient names, and support for Bangla in branded reports.

Does it support bKash and card payments?

The free core lets staff manually record cash, bKash, and card payments, including partial payments. Automatic payment verification through an online gateway is a planned separate extension.

What about X-ray, ultrasound, and ECG reports?

Narrative templates are included for imaging and special tests, with optional image or PDF attachments. PACS, DICOM, and advanced medical image viewing are outside the scope.

How do we get started?

Start by preparing your test list, prices, staff roles, center branding, and report formats. Use the setup checklist below to organize what your center needs. The interfaces on this site are illustrative product previews.
